caption: Kar. 44. Stela
reading: wosi : sore (2)yi : sintme(3)qowi : mk?l?s?ḫe : (4)mntowi : q?ni : (5)ẖ?s?towi : tẖ?e?s(6)ḫid?e : teri(7)kelowi : yi(8)tee?i : d?ḫelo(9)wi
notes: Line 2 number stands over the y of soreyi, after a clear gap, so 'sore (2)yi'. In the name the e (S) has a dot under it, read e. '/3' in 'qowi' (lines 3) and 'q?ni' (line 4) could be o+s instead of q; in 'sore' the same shape is read s+o. Line 3 second word: m (7-shape) then a flat-topped Z with a long tail (k?, possibly p, or a if the small s-shaped sign before it is the S of a), small s-shape (l?), 3 (s?, could be ẖ/m), ḫ (⊏), e. In '(4)mntowi' the m (7-shape) is crossed by the long tail of n; to is a loop (ɷ). '(5)ẖ?s?towi': first 3 has a long tail (ẖ, could be m), second a short tail (s or m). Line 5-6 word: t, 3 with long tail (ẖ or m), S (e or l), closed 3 (s), ḫ, i, crossed sign (d or ñ), e. Line 8: 'yi' is 4 with two strokes (same group as in soreyi); the S after te could be e or l. Line 9: first sign crossed (d or ñ); the c with an inner tick read ḫ (could be to). Text ends without a divider.

caption: Kar. 45. Altar
labels: about 30 lost, at the right of the copy row that carries lines 9-10 (stands where lines 6-8 would be, before line 9)
notes: Line 1 'wosi' is drawn in thin line (faint on the stone) and has no divider after it. The e of sore is crossed by a crack. Line 3: '/3' read q (could be s+o); m is a J/ℸ shape. After a gap: te, then a hatched sign with a rising stroke and hook (d?, damaged), o, ϟ (l, could be te if the slash belongs to it), i, a (S+2), q, o, w, i. Line 4 first word q?ni as in Kar. 44. 'm?nitowi': first sign a 3/ℸ crossed by the tail of n. Line 5: b, then a 3 with long tail joined to a 4 (read n, could be k) and i; the crossed/hooked sign before e read d (could be ñ); a thin crack with a dot ends the row. Lines 6-8: about 30 signs lost (Griffith's note), written as 30 [.]. Line 9 te and r are drawn thin (faint); the next e is crossed by a crack. Line 9-10: k = flat-topped Ʒ with long tail; in lebkwi the same. Line 10-11 benediction: 'ato' has hatching under the to; a 3 with long tail = m, closed 3 = ẖ in mẖe; p is a Σ/{-topped sign with long tail (by the formula; the hand key gives that shape to k). In 'ps(11)iḫte' a slash stands between s and an L-shaped i; it may be part of the i (Ꮭ with bar) or an o. Line 12 a: the S part of a is hatched. 'psḫrbḫte': V read b. Line numbers 11 and 12 stand near i and te inside the words. Last copy row (c and ) with a thin line, perhaps a crack) read ḫm, no line number; may continue line 12 or be a further line.

caption: Kar. 46. Altar
labels: sic, over the last sign of beloloke, by line 4
notes: No divider after wosi. A wide blank follows 'soreyi :' before '(3)yi'. Line 3: yi is a 4 with three strokes (as in soreyi); n? is a small ʌ with a hooked tail (could be d); t has its dot; b is ν with hooked arm; 'li' = ϟ then 4; the two S-shapes before q read e e (either could be l). Line 4 'beloloke': the second l is a hooked S, the second o a bent stroke (<), k a Ʒ with long tail; the last sign (e) is blotted/hatched and marked 'sic'. Line 5: a = S+2; the sign after a is a J-shape (m?) crossed by n's tail; C before w read ḫ (could be a second form of to). Line 6 number stands over the S just before the divider, so 'ḫmlo(6)e'; that S may be l. Line 6-7: '/3' read q (could be s+o), then e, k (Ʒ with long tail), e, te; line 7 number stands over te.
